info.description: API for managing dog care activities, reservations, passes and users. Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT obtained from the login endpoint.
info.title: DogPaw API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all activities in the system, most recent first. Limit defaults to 50 and is capped at 100. Offset defaults to 0.

parameters.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of activities to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

post.description: Creates a new school activity (class, route, individual session, or extra). Returns the new resource URL in the Location header.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing fields

get.description: Returns a paginated list of activities scheduled at or after the current time, soonest first.

parameters.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of activities to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.description: Returns a single activity by its id.

patch.description: Partially updates an activity. Only the supplied fields are mutated; an empty body is a no-op.

400.description: Invalid id, body, or validation error

post.description:
Closes an activity after it has finished. Batch-
processes every CONFIRMED reservation: those whose
id appears in no_show_reservation_ids are marked as
NO_SHOW, the rest are marked as COMPLETED. Then
the activity is marked as closed and persisted.
The entire flow runs in a single transaction.

400.description: Invalid id, activity not finished, or invalid reservation IDs

409.description: Activity already closed or reservation not confirmed

get.description:
Returns the views of every reservation for the
given activity, ordered by created_at ASC. Class
roster view.

parameters.description: Maximum number of reservations to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of reservations to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. On success it returns a signed JWT (HS256) and the user profile. The token expires after 24 hours and carries the user ID (sub) and role (role) claims.
post.summary: Authenticate user and return a JWT token

400.description: Invalid request body (malformed JSON, missing email, missing password)

patch.description: Verifies the current password and replaces it with a new one. Requires a valid Bearer JWT in the Authorization header. The new password must be at least 8 characters and different from the current one.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error (e.g. short new password)

401.description: Missing or invalid token, wrong old password, or inactive user

409.description: New password matches the old one

post.description: Completes user registration using a valid invitation token. The token must be in PENDING status and not expired (48h lifetime). The password must be at least 8 characters. Returns the created user profile without the password hash.
post.summary: Register a new user with an invitation token

400.description: Invalid request body, missing fields, or validation error (e.g. short password)

409.description: Token already used, expired, or revoked

get.description: Returns the full dog record including incompatibilities.

delete.description: Removes a dog by id. Associated dog_incompatibilities and reservations rows are deleted automatically by the database (ON DELETE CASCADE). Returns 404 if the dog does not exist.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing dog. Only the fields present in the request body are modified; omitted fields are preserved. An empty body is a no-op and returns 200 without touching the database. Designed for fixing typos (e.g. "Labarador" -> "Labrador") or correcting registration mistakes.

parameters.description: Fields to patch (only the fields you want to change)
parameters.name: dog

200.description: Dog patched (or no-op if body was empty)

400.description: Invalid id, invalid request body, or validation error (e.g. empty name, negative weight, invalid sex)

patch.description: Fast-path endpoint to flip the heat flag. Body is {"heat": true|false}. Returns 400 with error "invalid_heat_for_sex" if heat=true is attempted on a non-female dog.
patch.summary: Set the heat flag of a dog

post.description: Idempotently attaches an existing incompatibility (looked up by id) to a dog. If the dog already has that incompatibility, returns 200 with `added: false` and the current list (no DB write). Otherwise persists the change and returns 201 with `added: true` and the updated list. Both the dog and the incompatibility must exist.
post.summary: Add an incompatibility to a dog

200.description: Incompatibility was already attached (added=false, idempotent no-op)

400.description: Invalid id, invalid body, or validation error

delete.description: Idempotently detaches an existing incompatibility (looked up by id) from a dog. If the dog does not have that incompatibility, returns 200 with the current list (no DB write). Otherwise persists the change and returns 200 with the updated list. Both dog and incompatibility must exist; 404 otherwise.
delete.summary: Remove an incompatibility from a dog

200.description: Incompatibility removed (or no-op if not present), with the current list

patch.description: Fast-path endpoint to flip the neutered flag. Body is {"neutered": true|false}. Returns the new state plus the dog's sex. Returns 404 if the dog does not exist.
patch.summary: Set the neutered flag of a dog

get.description:
Returns the views of every reservation for the

get.description:
Returns all incompatibilities, optionally filtered by
level and/or kind.

post.description:
Creates a new incompatibility category (a TRAIT with a
stable code, or a TRIGGER pointing at the code of the
trait it reacts to). The name must be unique
(case-insensitive); trait codes must be unique too.

409.description: Name or trait code already exists

get.description: Returns a single incompatibility by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes an incompatibility. Fails with 409 if it is still referenced by any dog.

409.description: Incompatibility is in use by at least one dog

patch.description:
Partially updates an incompatibility (name, level, kind,
code and/or target_trait_code). An empty body is a no-op.

400.description: Invalid id, body, or validation error

409.description: Name or trait code already exists

post.description: Creates a new PENDING invitation for a client to register. The returned 64-hex token must be delivered to the client's email. The invitation expires in 48 hours. The created_by field must reference an existing admin user id.

400.description: Invalid request body, missing fields, or validation error

patch.description:
Partially updates a pass. Only price, pass_type, and
expires_at are editable. num_of_sessions,
remaining_sessions, user_id, and created_at are
immutable to preserve the audit-log invariant. An
empty body is a no-op.

400.description: Invalid id, body, or field value

Returns the views of every reservation paid from

parameters.description: Maximum number of reservations to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of reservations to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.description: Returns the email of every registered user, ordered by user id. Intended for the admin panel (e.g. bulk communications). Admin only.
Returns the public profile of a user. The password hash is never included in the response.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an existing user. Only the fields present in the request body are modified; omitted fields are preserved. An empty body is a no-op and returns 200 without touching the database. The password is never writable through this endpoint.

parameters.description: Fields to patch (only the fields you want to change)
parameters.name: user

200.description: User patched (or no-op if body was empty)

400.description: Invalid id, invalid request body, or validation error (e.g. empty name, malformed email)

post.description: Flips the user's is_active flag to false. Idempotent: deactivating an already-inactive user is a no-op and returns 200. The user's data is preserved. Use this for off-boarding instead of hard delete.

get.description:
Returns the denormalized ReservationView for every
reservation whose dog is owned by the user in the
path, ordered by created_at DESC. Supports
optional filters: status, from, to.

parameters.description: Filter by status (CONFIRMED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED_IN_TIME, CANCELLED_LATE, FORGIVEN, NO_SHOW)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Maximum number of reservations to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of reservations to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

post.description:
Books a dog into an activity, paid from one of the
owner's passes. Atomically: validates the activity
is in the future and not full, the dog is owned by
the user in the path, and the pass is owned by the
user and has at least one session. Consumes one pass
session and creates the reservation in StatusConfirmed.
post.summary: Book a reservation for a dog

400.description: Invalid user_id, request body, or missing fields

get.description:
Returns the views of every CONFIRMED reservation
whose activity date is at or after the current
time, ordered by activity date ASC.

parameters.description: Maximum number of reservations to return (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of reservations to skip for pagination (default 0)
parameters.name: offset

get.description:
Returns the denormalized ReservationView for the
given reservation id, owned by the user in the
path. Returns 404 if the id does not exist OR if
the reservation belongs to a different user (no
leak).

post.description:
Cancels a CONFIRMED reservation owned by the user in
the path. The activity must still be in the future
and the reservation must be in StatusConfirmed. If
the cancel happens more than 2h before the activity
date, the reservation transitions to
StatusCancelledInTime AND the pass session is
refunded (remaining_sessions + 1, audit movement +1
appended). If the cancel happens within the late
window, the reservation transitions to
StatusCancelledLate and no refund is applied (an
admin can later call Forgive to refund it).

409.description: Already cancelled / not in a cancellable state

post.description:
Transitions a CONFIRMED reservation to COMPLETED.
The activity must have already finished
(date + duration < now). Does not refund the pass
session because the session was consumed at
registration and the activity has been delivered.
Owner-only: the user_id in the path must own the
dog. Returns 404 if the reservation does not exist
OR belongs to a different user (no leak).

400.description: Invalid user_id / reservation_id, or activity has not finished yet

post.description:
Admin-only. Promotes a PENDING_TO_CONFIRM reservation
(created with only MEDIA/BAJA compatibility conflicts)
to CONFIRMED. The slot is already held, so no capacity
re-check is performed.

Transitions a CONFIRMED reservation to NO_SHOW.
The activity must have already started
(date < now). Does not refund the pass session
because the slot is past. Owner-only: the
user_id in the path must own the dog. Returns 404
if the reservation does not exist OR belongs to
a different user (no leak).

400.description: Invalid user_id / reservation_id, or activity has not started yet

post.description:
Admin-only. Demotes a PENDING_TO_CONFIRM reservation to
CANCELLED_IN_TIME (freeing the slot) and refunds the
pass session consumed at booking.
